# Dear ImGui 1.90.1 (vendored)

Unmodified copy of Dear ImGui v1.90.1 from https://github.com/ocornut/imgui
(release tarball `v1.90.1.tar.gz`, SHA-256
`21dcc985bb2ae8fe48047c86135dbc438d6980a8f2e08babbda5be820592f282`):
the core sources and headers, and the SDL2 and OpenGL 3 backends.
`imgui_demo.cpp` is included because `imgui.cpp` refers to its functions.

Licence: MIT, copyright (c) 2014-2024 Omar Cornut; see `LICENSE.txt`.
MIT is compatible with this project's GPL-3.0-or-later.

Vendored so that the programs build on every distribution: only Debian and
Ubuntu ship ImGui as a library package.
